local_changes: Checked CLM1 meshlets with <=64 vertices and <=124 triangles, full normals/UVs/tint and per-triangle material/component IDs.
Interpolated vertex tint multiplies spectral material albedo.
UV-sampled Planck emission from a temperature texture, using retained thermal fields.
Constant-time emitter PDF lookup for meshes with many emissive triangles.
Indexed meshlet triangles share float32 vertex blocks during native tracing; double-precision intersection math and SAH BVH are retained. Analytic primitive data uses copy-on-write value semantics.
Exact thread-local ray-intersection reuse across spectral wavelengths, keyed by every ray coordinate/time/clipping interval and unique BVH generation; no quantization.
Additional native regression checks for compact storage, copy-on-write geometry and exact ray-cache clipping/time/rebuild semantics.
First-hit guides evaluate UV texture, vertex tint and nested normal maps; display filtering retains albedo edges.
Per-texel absolute perceptual roughness textures drive isotropic GGX evaluation and sampling.
UV-derived surface tangent frames preserve mirrored UV and backface handedness.
Mapped-normal BSDF evaluation and sampling consistently reject reflection/transmission on the wrong geometric surface side.
